standard_prerequisites.name: The numerical type of a model, divisibility of the degree by the residue field degree, and the exact sequence of the regular model
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a regular model the numerical type records the multiplicities, the genera and the intersection numbers of the components; the degree of any invertible sheaf on a component is divisible by the degree of the residue field extension of that component, which is what makes the divided-degree map well defined; and the Picard group of the model fits into the exact sequence determined by the multiplicities with the Picard group of the curve as its quotient. The author's own definitions and the two lemmas of this chapter that the proof quotes by name are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted map is the bridge used in this section to compare the Picard group of the curve with the combinatorial Picard group of the numerical type, and its kernel description is what turns the comparison into an exact sequence of torsion groups.

core_obligations: Recall that the weights of the components are the degrees of their residue field extensions and that the degree of any invertible sheaf on a component is divisible by the corresponding weight, which is the quoted divisibility lemma of the Varieties chapter; this makes the divided-degree map on the Picard group of the model well defined (source lines 5926-5930).

Introduce that map from the Picard group of the model to the free module on the components, sending an invertible sheaf to the tuple of its degrees on the restrictions, each divided by the weight of the component (source lines 5930-5936).

Compute the image of the sheaf attached to a component: the degree of its restriction to another component is the intersection number of the two components, so the image is exactly the tuple of divided intersection numbers, which is the image of a basis vector under the matrix defining the Picard group of the numerical type (source lines 5937-5943).

Assemble the resulting commutative diagram of two exact rows, the upper one presenting the Picard group of the curve as a quotient of that of the model and the lower one presenting the Picard group of the numerical type as the cokernel of the divided intersection matrix, and read the kernel description of the canonical map off the diagram (source lines 5944-5960).

proof_roadmap.step: Divisibility of the degrees by the weights makes the divided-degree map well defined.
Definition of the divided-degree map on the Picard group of the model.
Image of a basis vector equals the divided intersection numbers, matching the matrix of the numerical type.
Commutative diagram of two exact rows and the resulting description of the kernel.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-canonical-map-of-pic（源 5911-5923 行，证明 5925-5960 行）：存在典范映射 Pic(C)→Pic(T)，其核恰是那些由 X 上的可逆层限制而来、且在每个 C_i 上度数为 0 的可逆层。关键操作不是例行核验：先要用「C_i 上可逆层的度数被 w_i=[κ_i:k] 整除」把除以权重的映射 deg/w 定义好（5926-5936 行），再算 O_X(C_j) 在该映射下的像恰是 (a_1j/w_1,…,a_nj/w_n)，即定义数值类型 Picard 群的矩阵 (a_ij/w_i) 作用在第 j 个基向量上的像（5937-5943 行），最后把上行的 0→Z→Z^⊕n→Pic(X)→Pic(C)→0（由同章正则模型可逆层正合列给出）与下行的 0→Z^⊕n→Z^⊕n→Pic(T)→0 拼成两行正合的交换图，从图上读出核的刻画（5944-5960 行）。难点在于必须先证明除法的合法性，才能让「除以权重」这一步成为良定义的模映射；原文位置在证明的 5926-5936、5937-5943、5944-5960 行，图由 13 行的 xy 矩阵给出。
